newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee and cocoa head lower, sugar off AM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee and cocoa head lower, sugar off AM.

text.p: COFFEE - All positions still down after a lower start as expected. Sept off $28 at $2,087 at 1006 GMT. Support seen at $2,040.
COCOA - Front positions near key support as market extends overnight losses. July off 12 stg at 982, approaches 980 support.
SUGAR - Thinly traded and prices drift slightly lower. Aug down 90 cents at $327.50.
